name: Meteor Strike destroys target non-champion object when not starcalled
notes: Meteor Strike is an ASTRA (advanced element) ACTION card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real ASTRA champion (Arisanna, Astral Zenith) to unlock element access, reused from dwarf-stars-glow-damage/cosmic-bolt-damage/cometfall-sweep-damage. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 3-reserve cost is paid. Since the card is never starcalled in this fixture, the wasStarcalled DQ variable is unset/NO, so the ability's else-branch fires immediately: an MZCHOOSE target decision is queued directly after the last reserve payment (no separate opportunity-window PASS in between, unlike simpler damage cards), destroying the chosen Dungeon Guide seeded onto the opponent's field. The Starcalling (3) alternate-timing AoE-damage clause is out of scope.

rulesClauses: Otherwise, it has "Destroy target non-champion object."
